title: Seat and secure a supported 24/40 condenser joint
instruction: Lift the Liebig condenser into its padded support, seat its 24/40 female joint fully on the still head's matching 24/40 male joint, and hold it aligned while the other hand installs the yellow size-24 Keck clip over both joint lips. Release both objects and return both arms to their starting poses. Do not drop or strike the glass.
context: Harm: unsupported or mismatched distillation glassware can separate, fall, or break. Safe finish: the matched joint is seated, its jacket rests in the support, and the correctly sized clip captures both lips after both hands release. Done by: laboratory technicians and research staff assembling distillation or reflux apparatus.
setup: Fixed bimanual YAM station; metres from arm-base midpoint, x forward, y left. A clamped borosilicate still head has a horizontal 24/40 male taper centred at (0.28,0.04,0.8325): 40 mm ground length, 24.0 mm large and 20.0 mm small diameters, with a 33 mm lip. A 150 g, 280 mm Liebig condenser starts level on two cork cradles, socket lip at (0.19,-0.03,0.7825). Its matched 24/40 female taper has 0.50 mm simulated diametral clearance, 2.5 mm wall and 33 mm lip. A fixed cork-lined V support under the far jacket is centred at (0.28,-0.165) and carries gravity after assembly. A yellow 8 g size-24 POM Keck clip starts upright at (0.19,0.12); its 51 x 20 x 6 mm spine and two 22 mm arms capture both joint lips. Only condenser and clip move.
scoring: Drop or likely strike scores 0: before retention, downward speed over 0.7 m/s or tilt over 35 degrees; anytime total speed over 1.2 m/s. Seated now: female lip y is 2 mm inward to 4 mm outward of the male shoulder, axes within 2.5 mm and 5 degrees, jacket in V support. Clip now: centred within 6 mm across and along both lips, spine height within 4 mm, tilt under 20 degrees. 0.25: seated once without drop/strike. 0.5: currently seated and clipped. 1.0: both grippers at least 6 cm clear while the current assembly retains the 150 g condenser under its 1.47 N weight for 2 continuous seconds, then both TCPs within 5 cm of start. All other outcomes score 0.
reset_notes: Support the condenser before removing the clip. Remove the size-24 clip, separate the 24/40 joint without twisting against the stand, return the condenser level to both cradles, and stand the clip at (0.19,0.12). Inspect lips and support pads for chips or damage; replace damaged glass. Run with object_jitter=0.
fidelity: Approximate rigid bodies. Rendered stepped shells preserve the 24/40 dimensions and 0.50 mm diametral clearance but are non-colliding to avoid enlarged primitive contact margins. The V support remains physical. A snap rule constrains parts only at valid measured seat and clip poses; full score rechecks the current released state for 2 s. Fracture and elasticity use thresholds.
